pins.name: Rachel Lake Trailhead
pins.evidence: Route text starts at the Rachel Lake trailhead at the end of FR 4930; the harvested round-trip tracks all start/end within ~150 m of this point (about 47.4005,-121.2833).

facts.text: On summer weekends the trailhead lot fills early; leaving around 7 AM in July got one party ahead of the crowds on the Rachel Lake trail.
By mid-October patches of slushy snow start near 5,000 ft and two steep snowfields below the ridge call for an ice axe.

Several of these may be one line filed more than once. Trailhead is closed by a fire alert posted July 2026 per the trail page; not a catalog fact.
